$schema_note: HAR-18 fourth-task admission packet slice: Peter-only registration checklist and contract specification
scope: Source-only gate description, not a registry record or certification packet. All execution steps below remain deferred and require separate authorization; this correction grants none.

contract_correction.basis: PR398 review and current materializer, package_layout, CLI, registry, schema and task_workbench producers in this tree
contract_correction.supersedes: Earlier prospective no-seed registry/control IDs and hand-authored certification/license claims only; original source pins, receipts, authorizations and the three-task HAR-14 freeze are unchanged.
contract_correction.identity_rule: Keep cell_id=dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42 as the generator selector. The proposed registry ID, default materialized directory basename, native result/lock suffix and workbench task_id are action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42; task.toml declares evallab/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42.

peter_registration_gate.factory_write_restriction: Factory, subagents, and automated runners are strictly prohibited from writing to library/registry. Any automated modification of library/registry violates Eval Lab trust and admission policy.
peter_registration_gate.cli_command: After a candidate record exists and Peter approves: evallab registry register action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42 --actor "Peter Makhnatch" --certification-packet research/registration/candidates/<candidate_id>/certification.json
registration_invariants: actor must be non-empty and specify approving human actor (--actor 'Peter Makhnatch')
task must already exist as candidate record in library/registry or be promoted via explicit candidate flow
certification envelope state must be 'bound' for any new task registration (legacy_missing is prohibited for new tasks)
task package directory must exist at task_path with all components: task.toml, instruction, environment, and verifier
on-disk package digests must match record.digests byte-for-byte across all component hashes
control evidence must be committed and present with oracle.reward == 1.0 and nop.reward == 0.0
control evidence paths, trial locks, and harbor_task_digests must match current disk package bytes
state transitions strictly to 'registered', approved_by becomes actor, approved_at is recorded in UTC, and state_reason is set to null

har14_cohort_freeze_gate.rule: HAR-14 active evaluation cohort remains frozen until Peter completes explicit registration of the fourth-slot task.
cohort_constraints: dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42 must NOT be referenced in active experiment matrices or evaluation specs prior to registration.
The fourth slot remains strictly in candidate/staged status; no automated runner or benchmark dispatch may consume it as a registered task.
TaskRegistry.resolve_spec refuses missing records with TaskNotRegisteredError and non-registered records with TaskStateInvalidError.
Peter registration is the gating event that unfreezes the evaluation cohort to admit the fourth task alongside existing cohort members.

task_id.description: Proposed registry identity matching the default materialized directory basename and namespaced task.toml name suffix (3-80 chars), not the generator cell_id.

task_family.description: Explicit --task-family action-memory-v1 is required: the generated task.toml declares neither task.family nor metadata.task_family.

version.description: Semantic version of the task package.

task_path.description: Repository-relative path to task package directory; no leading slash, no '..'.

digests.description: Canonical SHA-256 digests of all package files and the aggregate package directory.

source_ref.description: External repository commit hash or release tag; null for local/synthetic tasks.

license.description: Inferred from metadata.license emitted by library/benchmarks/action-memory-v1/package_layout.py:task_toml. Do not override the selected unmodified package's license.

provenance_zone.description: Zone classification; 03-synthetic for dose-ladder generated tasks.

is_synthetic.description: Flag marking whether the task is synthetically generated.

limits.description: Execution limits enforcing runtime constraints (timeout 1-21600 seconds, memory, CPUs).

control_evidence.description: Promoted oracle and nop evidence references; required when state is registered.

certification.description: Workbench certification packet envelope; state must be 'bound' for new registrations.

state.description: Admission state; 'registered' upon completion of Peter's approval.

allowed_uses.description: Schema permits these items, but this proposal requests measurement only. Pass --allowed-uses measurement explicitly; the promote default also includes training and is not authorized here.

value.basis: synthetically generated Action Memory dose-ladder cell; not in pretrain data

human_minutes.description: Expert human completion time estimate in minutes.

approved_by.description: Approving human actor; strictly required when state == 'registered'.

approved_at.description: Timestamp of Peter's approval; strictly required when state == 'registered'.

state_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for non-registered states; must be null when state == 'registered'.

oracle_contract.execution_notes: Native Harbor oracle executes against the materialized package with live FastMCP sidecar container (solve_via_mcp) or direct solver (solve_direct). Reward must equal 1.0 exactly.

nop_contract.execution_notes: NOP agent takes zero action or immediate return; verifier must score exactly 0.0 with no leakage or default-pass bugs.

evidence_verification_checks: evidence_path must be relative to repo and begin with 'research/evidence/runs/'
evidence result.json must exist and its SHA-256 match evidence_digest
sibling trial lock.json must exist and its SHA-256 match lock_digest
evidence ref task_id and task_version must match TaskRegistryRecord
evidence ref task_digests must match TaskRegistryRecord.digests
harbor_task_digest must match fresh harbor_task_digest() computed from on-disk package
native result task_name suffix and result/config/lock task path basenames must match the proposed registry task_id, including -seed42
trial lock task version or digest must match registered package

certification_bound_shape.producer_contract: src/evallab/task_workbench.py:_certification_record produces the packet; src/evallab/registry.py:certification_envelope_from_packet validates it and rebuilds the stored envelope. Never hand-author or copy this gate description as an envelope.

producer_derived_fields.certification_id: Use the content-derived cert- ID from the actual certified packet.
producer_derived_fields.packet_sha256: Computed from actual packet bytes by certification_envelope_from_packet.
producer_derived_fields.candidate_id: Use the candidate- ID derived by inspect_candidate from the exact task identity.
producer_derived_fields.candidate_package_digest: Use the verified task_binding.candidate_package_digest, not an invented or substituted registry digest.
producer_derived_fields.package_digest: Use the verified task_binding.package_digest matching TaskRegistryRecord.digests.package.
producer_derived_fields.control_summary: Copy the producer's observation-derived counts and result_digests; no control count or digest in this proposal is evidence.
producer_derived_fields.axes: Copy the emitted axes with their actual reasons and cited control IDs. The first four axes must pass. m049-v1 emits difficulty_calibration=not_applicable and realism_review=not_assessed; local controls neither calibrate difficulty nor establish realism.
producer_derived_fields.generator_identity: Copy the candidate's solution digest/local execution identity.
producer_derived_fields.validator_identity: Copy the candidate's distinct verifier digest/local execution identity.

envelope_invariants: packet_path must stay repo-relative, start with 'research/registration/candidates/', and end in '/certification.json'
package_digest in envelope must match TaskRegistryRecord.digests.package exactly
generator_identity and validator_identity must be distinct (self-check prohibition)
stored certification envelope must equal the envelope rebuilt from the hash-bound packet; it is not byte-identical to the packet's different schema
please_hack_executed must be true and hack_detected false; all other listed check_vector flags must be true and must match digest-verified observations

step_1_staging.action: Execute scripts/mcp_funcdag/ensure_wheelhouse.py to stage FastMCP 3.4.7 wheels at /tmp/fastmcp3_wheelhouse and generate resolver-provenance.json.

step_2_materialization.action: Call materialize_dose_ladder_cell(seed=42, dose_bytes=16384, arm='semantic_distractor'). Do not pass a cell_id string or plan_only. Default output is derived/harbor-tasks/action-memory-dose-ladder/<digest>/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42.
step_2_materialization.prerequisite: Step 1 complete with verified wheels and provenance.

step_3_control_evidence.action: Run native Harbor oracle and nop trials on materialized task package to collect durable evidence under research/evidence/runs/.
step_3_control_evidence.verification: Confirm oracle reward == 1.0 and nop reward == 0.0.

step_4_certification_packet.action: Run task_workbench certification suite to produce research/registration/candidates/candidate-<id>/certification.json.
step_4_certification_packet.verification: Use certification_envelope_from_packet on the actual producer packet: required flags are true except hack_detected=false, workbench_version is m049-v1, and the rebuilt envelope is bound. Do not replace emitted axes, reasons, identities or digests with this proposal.

step_5_candidate_record.action: Only after separate authorization and the deferred prerequisites, Peter may run cli_command with the actual materialized path. This creates a candidate, not an admission. Factory must not write library/registry.
step_5_candidate_record.cli_command: evallab registry promote <materialized-package> --task-id action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42 --task-family action-memory-v1 --source-uri synthetic/action-memory-v1/dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42@1.0.0 --provenance-zone 03-synthetic --synthetic --allowed-uses measurement --state candidate
step_5_candidate_record.result: library/registry/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42.json exists as a candidate with durable discovered controls. License is inferred from the package; certification is bound from the actual packet at Peter's later register step.

step_6_peter_registration.action: Only after Peter's separate approval, execute 'evallab registry register action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42 --actor "Peter Makhnatch" --certification-packet research/registration/candidates/<candidate_id>/certification.json'.
step_6_peter_registration.result: Transitions the existing candidate record to state='registered'. Does not create the file from nothing. HAR-14 freeze may then add this task by a new Factory cohort revision, not by rewriting history.
